page.notes: Right margin notes transcribed at their reference points: g (Nauar. quoniam supra.), b (Extravag. l.f. cap.Dudum.), i (Ibid.), k (Azorius Inst. Moral.part.2.c.4.). Running head and page number read clearly. "filem" in "Christi filem" appears as printed; likely a printing error for "filium", left as printed. The reference marks g, b, i and k are small superscript letters and are read with some uncertainty. The end of the last line is cut off by the signature area and the catchword "ritate" completes the word "authoritate".
